title: The impact of experimental designs & system sloppiness on the personalisation process: A cardiovascular perspective
why_it_matters: Cardiovascular model sloppiness and experimental-design dependence of parameter personalisation; directly limits any claim that measurement-dependent cardiovascular identifiability is new.
why_not_direct_collision: No vascular-age question, no arterial pulse finite codebook, no exhaustive cross-age state aliases, and no physiological alias-rescue analysis.

title: Assessing input parameter hyperspace and parameter identifiability in a cardiovascular system model via sensitivity analysis
why_it_matters: Cardiovascular parameter identifiability, condition-number/sensitivity analysis, and dependence on clinically relevant measurements.
why_not_direct_collision: Lumped systemic model personalisation; no age-conditioned pulse-wave aliasing or global cross-age non-uniqueness.

title: Structural identifiability analysis of a cardiovascular system model
why_it_matters: Shows pressure-only or volume-only output sets can be non-identifiable and mixed measurements can restore structural identifiability.
why_not_direct_collision: Structural model-parameter identifiability in a six-chamber lumped model, not vascular age or pulse-wave physiological aliases.

title: Practical identifiability and uncertainty quantification of a pulsatile cardiovascular model
why_it_matters: Explicit one-to-one parameter-to-output identifiability framing with sensitivity, subset selection, calibration, and uncertainty.
why_not_direct_collision: Calibrates a lumped pulsatile model to ventricular pressure/volume; no arterial-age pulse aliases or sensor rescue across ages.

title: In vivo repeatability of the pulse wave inverse problem in human carotid arteries
why_it_matters: Direct arterial pulse-wave inverse problem estimating arterial parameters from measured wall-displacement waves.
why_not_direct_collision: Local carotid inverse fitting and repeatability; no ageing factorial, cross-age aliases, or measurement-rescue topology.

title: Classification and regression of stenosis using an in-vitro pulse wave data set: Dependence on heart rate, waveform and location
why_it_matters: Controlled pulse-wave inverse problem with varied heart rate/waveform, stenosis states, and four peripheral pressure signals.
why_not_direct_collision: Disease-location classification/regression rather than age-conditioned physiological non-uniqueness; does not enumerate indistinguishable generating states.

title: An Inverse Problems Approach to Pulse Wave Analysis in the Human Brain
why_it_matters: Mathematical pulse-wave inverse problem estimating PWV and forward/backward components from MRI.
why_not_direct_collision: Intracranial wave-component reconstruction; no arterial ageing, global state degeneracy, or rescue across measurement arms.

title: Arterial pulse wave modeling and analysis for vascular-age studies: a review from VascAgeNet
why_it_matters: Key review of biophysical arterial pulse models and pulse-analysis methods for vascular-age assessment.
why_not_direct_collision: Frames extraction/assessment of vascular age and modelling limitations, not exhaustive falsification of uniqueness of age from known generating states.

title: Assessing hemodynamics from the photoplethysmogram to gain insights into vascular age: a review from VascAgeNet
why_it_matters: Reviews single/multiple PPG and PPG-plus-other-signal approaches to vascular age; emphasizes physiological determinants and measurement choices.
why_not_direct_collision: Does not formulate global cross-age generator ambiguity or enumerate physiological compensation aliases.

title: Vascular age acquired from the pulse signal: A new index to screen early vascular aging
why_it_matters: Direct pulse-derived vascular-age index and early vascular ageing screening.
why_not_direct_collision: Constructs a vascular-age estimator rather than testing whether age is globally identifiable from the pulse.

title: Modeling arterial pulse waves in healthy aging: a database for in silico evaluation of hemodynamics and pulse wave indexes
why_it_matters: Creates the 4,374-subject PWDB and demonstrates known cardiovascular determinants of pulse waves across age.
why_not_direct_collision: Foundational forward database paper; it does not pose or execute the locked exhaustive cross-age aliasing/rescue inverse experiment.

title: First-harmonic attenuation of radial pulse waves as a sensitive marker for vascular aging
why_it_matters: Very recent radial-pulse harmonic marker for vascular ageing, demonstrating continued activity in pulse-derived ageing phenotypes.
why_not_direct_collision: Marker/association study; no known generating-state inversion, global degeneracy, or rescue experiment.

title: Aged-related analysis of pressure pulse wave in the time and frequency domains
why_it_matters: Current radial-pressure age-group morphology and spectral analysis.
why_not_direct_collision: Group-difference characterization, not uniqueness/aliasing of age-conditioned physiological generators.

title: Discrimination of vascular aging using the arterial pulse spectrum and machine-learning analysis
why_it_matters: Pulse-spectrum machine-learning discrimination of vascular ageing.
why_not_direct_collision: Discriminative prediction/classification; does not test information-theoretic/global physiological non-uniqueness.
